summary: Docat is a self-hosted application designed for hosting versioned documentation. It provides a centralised server where you can publish and manage multiple versions of your project documentation.
goodFor: It suits small development teams or individual developers who want an internal, self-hosted alternative to third-party documentation hosting services.
watchOut: Development activity has been slowing down, which might mean slower responses to security issues or bugs over time.
deployNotes: Since it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure a persistent volume for storing the documentation files and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
